WITH film_copies AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
)
SELECT film_id, rating, copies,
       copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS difference_from_rating_average,
       copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average
FROM film_copies
ORDER BY difference_from_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10
